<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Alison has successfully booked the meeting for Wednesday at 15:00.
My final task is to send the confirmation email to all four partners.

The details for the email are:
-   Day: Wednesday
-   Start time: 15:00
-   Body: I need to write a clear and concise confirmation message.

I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function.
The task will then be complete.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.name: send_confirmation_email
function.arguments: {"body":"This email confirms the partners' meeting has been scheduled.\nPlease do not reply to this email.","start":"15:00","day":"Wed"}
